description: This PHP file defines the 'Authorize' controller class in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for handling authorization processes such as token management, verification, resetting, and UI rendering related to administrator security features.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class for managing administrator authorization, token creation, validation, and reset operations, including interactions with cookies, sessions, and external models.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads authorization page, manages token creation and validation, sets redirection and UI data.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles sending authorization codes, validating tokens, and returning JSON responses.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes submitted authorization codes, validates them, updates authorization status, and manages redirection.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Prepares authorization reset view if attempts exceed limit, or redirects if token is valid.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Creates a reset token and confirms linking, providing user feedback.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Handles token unlocking, resets authorizations based on email and code, logs out the user, and clears session data.
